identity.title: Timeline of events in Pokémon Journeys: The Series

leadText:
In , Ash Ketchum becomes a research assistant at the newly established Cerise Laboratory in Vermilion City, teaming up with his new Goh. Together, they travel across different regions to study Pokémon and their behaviors, sometimes accompanied by Professor Cerise's daughter, Chloe, who's seeking her own path in life. Along the way, Ash learns of and enters the Pokémon World Coronation Series, aiming to challenge the 's strongest Trainers and ultimately face the reigning Monarch, . Meanwhile, Goh aspires to every on his way to , inspired by a childhood encounter with the Mythical Pokémon and eventually joining the Project Mew research team to further his goal. Along the way, they encounter many of Ash's old friends and rivals and meet new friends and foes alike.

After the Masters Eight Tournament and parting ways with Goh, Ash reunites with his old friends and as he wanders the world and is ultimately made to think what being a "Pokémon Master" truly means to him.
